scope: Head-only public API top10 latency. Complete GPU coarse32 + native Q8 seeds + exact threshold + coarse filter + residual correction + sparse Q8 + compacted top10 + score gather, IDs and exact scores read back and ordered. Native GPU Q8/top10/gather and native CPU Q8/full-logit download/partial_sort10 references; reused buffers/index sets. Four warmup blocks excluded; all symmetric six-call blocks retained. Background Java/build activity uncontrolled; process counts include JVMs, not threads. Not model throughput/adoption.
